property_summary: When user Alice calls collectDrugs with Bob as referral, the claimedDrugs[Bob] after the call is 500 in the reference (dividing 2500 by 5) but 1250 in the buggy version (dividing 2500 by 2).
change_summary: Replace the referral bonus calculation: change the divisor from 5 to 2, so that the referral gets more drugs.
